In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Kallak assassin]] [[Jaris Kan]] was hired by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Garto]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shikaakwa]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Baron [[Volnos Ryo]]. However, Kan's '''assassination attempt''' was thwarted by Ryo's daughter [[Tasha Ryo|Tasha]].
